title: 贝莱德Egon：AI硬件撑起新兴市场，这轮行情还能走多远？
speaker: Egon Vavric

segments.en: Yeah, so I think the last few quarters, we see a really strong evidence, the emerging market have a really different drivers and probably different catalysts going through this quarter and also for 2027.
segments.zh: 过去几个季度我们看到非常强的证据：新兴市场有着截然不同的驱动因素，本季度乃至2027年的催化因素可能也不一样。

segments.en: And if you look at Korea Taiwan, I think they carry that market in a significant way.
segments.zh: 看韩国和台湾地区，它们在很大程度上撑起了这个市场。

segments.en: I think doubling last year on Korea side and also being one of the strongest performers this year.
segments.zh: 韩国方面去年翻倍，今年也是表现最强的市场之一。

segments.en: I believe that AI hardware and also the picks and shovel players for the hyperscalers will carry this market forward.
segments.zh: 我相信AI硬件，以及为超大规模云厂商提供配套的'卖铲子'企业，会继续推动这个市场向前。

segments.en: The debate always has started that we're going to have some point when those equipment will reach equilibrium and supply and demand kind of match each other.
segments.zh: 争论一直存在：某个时点这些设备会达到均衡，供需彼此匹配。

segments.en: That would be an interesting testing environment for this market that when we hit that point, how likely those stocks can carry on the same pace.
segments.zh: 那对这个市场会是一个有意思的考验：到了那个时点，这些权益资产还能否维持同样的节奏。

segments.en: I mean, this is the best question we're facing nowadays because we are fundamental investors and if you look at the earnings power and the cash generation of that business, this is something we haven't seen for many decades.
segments.zh: 这是当下我们面对的最好的问题。我们是基本面投资者，看这些企业的盈利能力和现金创造能力，这是几十年未见的。

segments.en: So in that sense, we genuinely believe that rally is a fundamental supported rally.
segments.zh: 从这个意义上说，我们真心认为这轮上行是有基本面支撑的。

segments.en: If you look at most of these companies in the headline, their earnings cager is actually matching or even exceeding the share price cager.
segments.zh: 看这些头部企业，它们的盈利增速实际上与股价涨幅相当，甚至超过股价涨幅。

segments.en: So I think that sense, I think we felt that we are on strong footings. But meantime, we still believe that this is cyclical industry.
segments.zh: 所以在这个意义上，我们觉得自己站在稳固的基础上。但同时我们仍然认为这是一个周期性行业。

segments.en: We have to have a capacity and capability to value those assets and decide probably some point next year or even 28. Most of this product will slow down and probably the earnings power of those companies ought to slow down.
segments.zh: 我们必须有能力对这些资产进行估值，并判断明年甚至2028年某个时点，大部分产品会放缓，这些企业的盈利能力也可能随之放缓。

segments.en: Today, probably, we are not there yet, but capital markets tend to price kind of the future. So we tend to be two, three quarters before those equity levels are reached. So it's going to be a really interesting year or two ahead of us.
segments.zh: 今天可能还没到那一步，但资本市场往往会提前定价未来。所以我们通常会提前两三个季度反映这些权益资产的水平。未来一两年会非常有意思。
